title: Arara email-service breach: Nishinomiya confirms 25,115 and Amagasaki 17,064 residents' email addresses leaked
what_changed: Read the primary notices: Nishinomiya City's final report (25,115 addresses), Amagasaki City's notice (17,064) and Arara's own notice (81,329,467 addresses taken). Status developing -> confirmed, validation single_source -> corroborated, source_tier primary; title, pin and org now name the cities with confirmed counts. ZATAZ's 77 million and nearly 400 clients differ from Arara's own 81,329,467 and up to about 380; Arara's own figure is now used.
